# Shared sourcing data contract

This is a synthetic automotive business portfolio inspired by GDPval E004/E005. Amounts and companies are generated, not original GDPval transactions. Seed 20261012025 is reproducible. Source-adaptation audit is private construction metadata. Public responses contain business facts, not task IDs, answers, winners, scores or solution recipes.

## Access and envelopes

GET /api/sourcing/programs?query=&offset=0&limit=50
GET /api/sourcing/programs/{program_id}
GET /api/sourcing/forecasts?program_id=&offset=0&limit=50
GET /api/sourcing/quotes?program_id=&supplier_id=&offset=0&limit=50
GET /api/sourcing/documents/{document_id}
GET /api/sourcing/engineering?program_id=&supplier_id=&offset=0&limit=50
GET /api/sourcing/contracts?program_id=&offset=0&limit=50
GET /api/sourcing/payments?program_id=&offset=0&limit=50
GET /api/sourcing/suppliers?query=&offset=0&limit=50

All lists additionally accept program_id, supplier_id and query. query searches case-insensitive record identifiers and stored business text; filters combine with AND. Stable lexical record_id ordering. offset >= 0; 1 <= limit <= 100. Empty filters return the entire domain through pagination. Example envelope:

```json
{"data":{"items":[{"program_id":"PRG-002","name":"Platform 002 headlamp sourcing"}],"total":150,"offset":1,"limit":1},"request_id":"req-..."}
```

Details: {"data":{...business record...},"request_id":"req-..."}. Document detail: {"data":{"document_id":"Q-021-0-base-r2","document_type":"quotes","source_version":2,"source_system":"Synthetic automotive sourcing ERP","record":{...raw fields...}},"request_id":"req-..."}.

X-Service-Token is required for /api routes. Tokens are generated by the trusted run controller, never printed or furnished to the model; MCP gateway forwards authenticated requests. Missing/wrong token 401. Invalid pagination 400. Unknown business record/domain 404. All non-GET API requests 403. ERP catalog/order source remains copied unchanged but original ERP APIs are blocked by the isolated calibration access filter. GET /health is an operator/readiness route, checks H2 and committed sourcing seed receipt; returns 503 while seeding. /api/judge is absent in this business service, including when a caller sets TASK_ENV_ENABLE_JUDGE. Trusted parent gateway may register a separate train-only judge; it must not place gold in env.

## Records and relationships

| Domain | Count | Fields and relationships |
|---|---:|---|
| programs | 150 | PRG-001..150; variants base/premium; vehicle_set, pieces_per_vehicle_set=2; fiscal_periods 2027..2030; as_of_date 2026-10-12; launch_date; supplier_ids; all forecast_document_ids; finance_policy_document_id; fx_document_id |
| suppliers | 18 | SUP-001..018; name,country,status,qualification_register |
| forecasts | 2400 | F-NNN-year-variant-rN; quantity, quantity_scope=full_fiscal_year, fiscal_period,variant,revision,approval_status,approved_at,replaces_document_id; effective_period Jan1-Dec31 |
| quotes | 1800 | Q-NNN-candidate-variant-rN; supplier_id,revision,issued_at,valid_through,approval_status,effective_period,variant,currency,uom,pieces_per_vehicle_set; tier_quantity_uom=vehicle_set,tier_application,price_tiers,period_price_multipliers; tooling/RD amounts and shared charge IDs |
| engineering | 900 | E-NNN-candidate-rN; assessed_at,approval_status,effective_period; qualification_status,required_actions,requalification_weeks,tooling_transfer_weeks; technical_coverage; annual_capacity allocated after other business |
| contracts | 80 | 40 programs with incumbent history; C-NNN-nomination and C-NNN-change; contract status,execution/cancellation dates; tooling/RD totals,payment fraction,refund fraction,title/credit; replacement authorization,launch/qualification deadline,transition amount/timing |
| payments | 80 | Two settled paid invoices per historic program; PAY-NNN-tooling/rd; invoice/contract identifiers,currency,invoice_total,amount_paid,paid_at,payment_status,refund_received,refund_status |
| documents | 5560 | Original raw commercial records above, plus program-specific finance and FX policy documents; detail access by referenced ID |

No public document-list aggregator exists; domain rows give document IDs, program links give policy/FX IDs. A document is stored separately in H2 and contains the raw source record. Document revisions are individually reachable, including nonbinding documents.

## Commercial conventions

- Money and rates are decimal strings; quantities and durations are integers. Convert with decimal arithmetic. Currency codes CNY/USD/EUR. Quote uom is vehicle_set or headlamp_piece; vehicle_set consists of two headlamps. Price-tier counters always use vehicle_set regardless of price UOM. Amounts have explicit scopes; tooling/RD charge IDs are shared by variant sheets and stable across revisions. An amendment replaces the quoted amount of that charge; it is not a new separate fee. replaces_document_id links variant quote source revisions.
- Quote tiers are graduated for one candidate and flat for two. Intervals are [cumulative_from_inclusive,cumulative_to_exclusive); null upper bound is unbounded. Thresholds vary 100000/120000/140000. Period multipliers vary by supplier and fiscal year. Tier quantity is the supplier award across both variants. The tooling recovery cap remains 100000 vehicle sets across both variants; replacement opening quantity is zero. Shared finance clauses specify approved fiscal-period mix allocation and equal RD shares, without providing a calculation sequence.
- Finance policy valuation_fiscal_period=2027, first_discounted_fiscal_period=2028 and annual_discount_rate=0.10 implement the source-aligned first-year undiscounted convention. Operating payment due dates are year-end; upfront R&D payment is due at award. Tooling is recovered through the quoted charge per delivered set up to its quantity cap; quoted piece prices exclude tooling and R&D. These are declared synthetic commercial terms used consistently; no original source ambiguity is silently resolved by a scorer.
- Forecast quantities are whole-year totals even where approval changes during source history. New draft revisions are not approved demand. Quotes include drafts, revoked revisions and approved amendments effective only from 2028. Prior approved sheets remain reachable. Approval status, approval/issue date, validity and covered fiscal period all matter; revision number alone is not authority. Explicit supersession links refer to historical documents; nonbinding proposals do not activate a supersession.
- FX documents quote CNY per one foreign unit for each fiscal period and upfront date. Engineering states are qualified/conditional; conditional entries list required actions. Readiness durations are measured from the requested decision date; tooling transfer and requalification are sequential for a reusable customer-owned asset. For a new-tooling nomination, requalification duration includes tooling preparation. Capacity quantities are available annual allocations after other awards. Both adequate and shortfall cases exist; no supplier is predesignated as winner.
- Ordinary nomination programs have no incumbent contract/payment records. Historical programs vary cancelled versus superseded disposition, supplier/customer tooling title, replacement authorization and partial versus unreceived refunds. Refund is 0.30 of actual settled eligible tooling/R&D payments, independent of the 0.30 initial deposit fraction. refund_received is actual receipt, not the claim entitlement. A usable customer-owned tooling credit reduces replacement tooling charge; it is not cash. Supplier-owned tools carry zero transfer credit. Transition cost has its own amount and timing.

All commercial records expose currency,uom,effective_period,approval_status. These interfaces supply raw facts for an independent actor; they do not compute feasibility, cost, preferred supplier or contractual recovery.
